leadText:
Lake Slowpoke (Japanese: ヤドン湖 Lake), also known as Lake Enlightenment, is an -exclusive location in Johto located between Mahogany Town and Blackthorn City. It appeared in Enlighten Up!.

 , , and arrived here when they were suddenly confronted by . They started a battle, but were interrupted by a , which was revealed to belong to , a student of the Slowpoke Temple that lies close to Lake Slowpoke.

After visiting the temple, Ash, Brock, Misty, and Madeleine returned to the lakeside were Misty wanted to fish. When Team Rocket stole the golden Slowpoke statue of the Slowpoke Temple and came rushing down towards the lake, Madeleine's Slowpoke evolved into after catching a with its tail. Slowbro managed to return the statue and defeat Team Rocket.
